title: Embedding cache RLS plan
description: Covers deny-by-default RLS expectations for embedding_cache. This table is not student-scoped: it carries no student_id, resource_id, or chunk_id column at all, by binding privacy constraint AD-30 (ENGINEERING-RULES.md ENG-238) - cache entries must never be attributable to any student. Every role other than service-role is denied every operation.

cases.caseName: authenticated role cannot select any embedding_cache row
authenticated role cannot insert an embedding_cache row
authenticated role cannot update an embedding_cache row
authenticated role cannot delete an embedding_cache row

ownership_notes: embedding_cache has no student_id column and is never attributable to any student (AD-30)
no foreign key from any student-scoped table ever references embedding_cache; correlation with chunk_embeddings is by (content_hash, embedding_strategy_version) value only, never by foreign key
no policy exists for any client-reachable role (ENG-304 secure default); only the service-role worker plane reads or writes this table
cache hits are invisible in every student-facing surface
index_notes: primary key (content_hash, embedding_strategy_version) is the sole cache lookup path
an HNSW cosine index on embedding is not required for cache reads, which are exact-key lookups, not similarity search
